This directory holds a Python library for styled terminal output. A Live display whose content renders nothing writes a stray blank line when it is left, even with transient=True. Reproduce it with:

```python
from rich.console import Console, Group
from rich.live import Live

console = Console(width=20, height=5, force_terminal=True)
console.begin_capture()
with Live(Group(), console=console, transient=True):
    pass
print(repr(console.end_capture()))
```

The captured text contains a newline. Nothing visible was ever drawn, so leaving the Live should not emit a line break: the only output should be the cursor hide and show codes and the line clearing around them. A Live that did render something must behave exactly as it does now, including the final line break. Do not edit any existing test file; put new tests in a new file under tests/. The existing suite (`python3 -m pytest tests`) must keep passing.
